domainDefinitions: Finite integer N>=0; p_t in[0,1]; d>-1 per matching period; end-period cash flows; all money one explicit currency/basis.
R_t and C_active_t are conditional on activity; C_unconditional_t is an expected unconditional cohort-per-customer cost, not survival-weighted again.
Unconditional costs are still time-discounted. CAC is t0 exactly once and excluded from all recurring costs.
No steady-state/churn conversion or retention distribution is selected.
